items.title: Fluence Energy, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results; Reaffirms Fiscal Year 2026 Guidance
items.snippet: Reported Q2 FY2026 results for the three and six months ended March 31, 2026; revenue of approximately $464.9 million; reaffirmed FY2026 guidance, including revenue of $3.2 billion to $3.6 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $40 million to $60 million.

items.title: Fluence Energy Q1 revenue jumps 154%, outlook held
items.snippet: Reported Q1 fiscal 2026 results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025; revenue around $475.2 million; reiterated FY2026 guidance including revenue of $3.2 billion to $3.6 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $40 million to $60 million.

items.title: Fluence Energy (FLNC) Is Up 22.9% After Record Backlog Coverage Lifts 2026 Revenue Outlook
items.snippet: States fiscal 2026 revenue guidance of US$3.2 billion to US$3.6 billion and says about 85% of the midpoint was already backed by a record US$5.3 billion backlog; notes risk of project delays or policy-driven pauses slowing conversion.
